alignments.note: Compound preposition מִלִּ rendered by the single *at*; heads on the first preposition (rule 23). Alternative: לְ `unrepresented` beside מִן → *at*.
Here the ASV writes a word for פָּנֶה itself, so no fusion with the preposition (rule 30); supplied *the* on the construct (rule 29).
Rectum takes the *of* (rule 19) and the supplied *the* (rule 15).
Imperative keeps only *Tremble*; the *thou* is read as the vocative's, standing before the noun (rule 36).

Vocative takes *thou* (rule 36). The pronoun stands both after the imperative and before the noun; the ASV's comma sets it with *earth*. Competing reading: *thou* as the imperative's subject pronoun under rule 17.
Compound preposition → *At*, headed on the first (rule 23).
פָּנֶה rendered *the presence* with a supplied *the* (rule 29).
Rectum of the outer chain takes *of*; construct of the inner chain takes the supplied *the* (rules 19, 29).
